goal.objective: Ship POST /auth/login + POST /auth/register endpoints with JWT issuance, Argon2 hashing, and rate limiting (5 req/min/IP).
goal.stopping_condition: All tests in tests/auth/*.test.ts pass, npm run typecheck exits 0, and curl POST /auth/login with valid creds returns 200 with a JWT in the response body.
out_of_scope: New dependencies beyond what's already in package.json

preconditions: PRD F01.000 (User model + DB schema) complete and merged to main
mission.expected_behavior: Given a user submits valid email and password to POST /auth/login, when the credentials match a stored Argon2 hash, then the response is 200 with {token, user} JSON and the token verifies against JWT_SECRET. Given invalid credentials, the response is 401 with {error: 'invalid_credentials'}. Given more than 5 requests in 60 seconds from the same IP, the response is 429 with Retry-After header.

slices.title: DB migration + user_credentials table
slices.proof: npx prisma migrate dev exits 0 and SELECT exists in user_credentials table verified via npx prisma studio

slices.title: POST /auth/login with JWT issuance
slices.proof: tests/auth/login.test.ts passes and emitted JWT verifies against JWT_SECRET

slices.title: Rate limiting middleware (5 req/min/IP)
slices.proof: tests/auth/rate-limit.test.ts demonstrates 6th request in 60s window returns 429
